responsibility: Defines the ISO mathematical function interface for REAL values, including constants, elementary transcendental and trigonometric functions, power and rounding operations, and the module-specific exception-status query. It is the normal-precision real-math specification parallel to LongMath and LowReal, exposing the public API gm2 programs use for REAL arithmetic helpers.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public specification of the REAL mathematics module, declaring constants and the available elementary, trigonometric, power, rounding, and exception-query operations. Its companion RealMath.mod is the implementation that binds those operations to builtins and libm.
